title: Quinoa vegetable pulao
summary: Pulao with quinoa instead of rice - roughly double the protein and triple the fibre, cooked the same way in one pot.

ingredients.note: Rinse it properly under running water or it tastes bitter and soapy.

steps: Heat the ghee. Fry the whole spices and cashews for 30 seconds until they smell fragrant.
Onion in, cook 4-5 minutes to soft and lightly golden. Then ginger, garlic and chilli for a minute.
Add all the vegetables and salt. Cook 3 minutes.
Add the rinsed quinoa and stir for a minute so every grain gets coated in fat.
Pour in the water, bring to a hard boil, then cover and drop to the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Do not lift the lid.
Turn the heat off and leave it covered another 5 minutes - this is when the grains finish and separate.
Fluff with a fork, stir through garam masala, coriander and lemon.
tips: The 1:1.75 ratio matters. Quinoa needs less water than rice and turns to mush if you treat it the same.
Little white spirals popping off the grains means it is done.
Pressure cooker: same method, 1:1.5 water, 2 whistles, natural release.
Add 200 g of paneer or a can of chickpeas in the last 5 minutes to turn it into a one-dish meal.
health_notes: Quinoa is a complete protein, unusual for a grain, and has about 5 g of fibre per cooked cup against under 1 g for white rice.

source.adapted: Standard veg pulao with quinoa in place of basmati and the water ratio corrected for it.
